news.title: AAE alumna and Blue Origin vice president Powers featured in 'Relentless' video series
news.summary_en: Audrey Powers, vice president of mission and flight operations at Blue Origin, shares how overcoming challenges as a student helped her entire career.

news.title: ME's Malshe leads first ever In-Space Manufacturing class
news.summary_en: To sustain operations in space, you have to be able to build in space. That’s the idea behind the first ever university course focused on In-Space Manufacturing — hosted by the Cradle of Astronauts, Purdue University.
